title: Document Ingestion Response
description: Response emitted by POST /applications/{id}/documents upon successful upload streaming, vault storage, and database persistence (Guide §4 S1).

detected_kind.description: Document format identified strictly by magic bytes

blake3.description: BLAKE3 cryptographic digest computed during upload streaming

sha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest computed during upload streaming

storage_key.description: Content-addressed key in vault storage (e.g. b3/<aa>/<bb>/<blake3>)

processing_state.description: Current processing state in ingestion gateway

ocr_status.description: OCR is not run during raw ingestion

persistence_status.description: Storage status: persisted in local content-addressed vault or S3-compatible object store

is_new_blob.description: True if blob was newly added; False if deduplicated against existing vault object

idempotent_replay.description: True if request was an idempotent replay with same idempotency key and content
